jcr:title: Constellation SENIOR PLAYERS Next Stop For Stryker Orthopaedics On 2016 PGA TOUR Champions

text.text:
MAHWAH, N.J., June 6, 2016 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Stryker Orthopaedics, announced it will be taking its presence in Philadelphia at the Constellation SENIOR PLAYERS one step further by spreading the message of joint health to consumers off the golf course. On Tuesday, June 7th, Stryker will engage with a variety of fans, through its event at Philly Mini Golf, located directly within Franklin Square Park.

From 10:00am to 4:00pm, Stryker, the Official Joint Replacement Products of the PGA TOUR and PGA TOUR Champions, will offer complimentary rounds of miniature golf as part of the company's dedication to raise awareness about the importance of keeping joints healthy in a fun and interactive way. Those stopping by Philly Mini Golf will find interesting tips throughout the course about the benefits of leading an active lifestyle. Stryker will also be offering consumers the chance to win a pair of tickets to the tournament.1
